shared_elements: single large human(oid) figure occupying almost the whole carved field
raised or extended arms with hands rendered
suggestion of banded or patterned garment/decoration across the body
justification: Both are stone monuments dominated by a single oversized anthropomorphic figure with a headdress, arms rendered against the body and disc/rosette motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a frontal, heavily eroded, quasi-three-dimensional block with barely legible ornament, while B is a crisply cut shallow relief of a strictly profile winged figure with dense linear detail, borders of plant motifs and inscribed text — the manner of rendering and the pictorial scheme are quite different.
